title: Camera Readiness & Spatial Extraction · v0.9.9
changes: Camera has explicit off, enabling, ready, saving and error states; closed grey eye switches to pink glowing eye with world-space instruction when camera is ready.
Only one source-image bloom, triggered after server confirms save; no second provisional card or interrupted animation.
Nested SAM segmentation operates on each privately owned extracted object image, with parent-child relationships and object-menu Segment action.
Recognition cards expand into a forward, upward-facing fan, not behind the capture or out of view.
Cards stay upright facing the wearer; moving a card preserves the initial controller-ray contact point instead of mixing grip and ray rotations.
Retains optional quota settings, existing user images, database, vault, controller experiments and watcher behavior.
